article.headline: Bellarmine secures 82-67 victory over Georgia Southern
article.description: — Tyler Doyle had 18 points in Bellarmine’s 82-67 win against Georgia Southern on Tuesday.
article.linkText: Bellarmine secures 82-67 victory over Georgia Southern
article.story: HIGHLAND HEIGHTS, Ky. -- — Tyler Doyle had 18 points in Bellarmine’s 82-67 win against Georgia Southern on Tuesday. Doyle also contributed five rebounds, six assists, and four steals for the Knights (3-5). Julius Gizzi scored 18 points while going 6 of 7 (4 for 5 from 3-point range). Sam Donald went 6 of 11 from the field (5 for 9 from 3-point range) to finish with 17 points. Truman Claytor IV finished with 18 points and five assists for the Eagles (3-5). Georgia Southern also got 13 points from Rashaad Williams. Dallas Gardner finished with nine points. Up next Georgia Southern: visits UNC Asheville on Saturday. Bellarmine: visits Northern Kentucky on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
